claims.statement: Evidence-first Research Mode and optional AI are documented product principles; no service-health claim.
Historical Research Mode records snapshot, history controls and source-provenance disclosures.
The historical Apple FY2024/FY2025 customer-contract revenue comparison displays $391.04B, $416.16B and +6.43%; no recalculation from rounded labels.
Historical JPM annual revenue comparison is Unavailable for incompatible scopes; the Apple causal question produces no deterministic direct answer.
Historical selected-filing presentation shows passages and disclosures; highlighting is not entailment validation and the capture predates keyword mode.
Committed keyword source implements explicit selected-filing, version-pinned metadata checks and case-insensitive substring ranking; no request is executed.
Keyword test definitions and offline records exist; browser/live acceptance remains NOT TESTED and the separate original review report remains MISSING.
Risk comparison source/design keeps issuer pins and partial results independent; no period alignment or comparative severity claim.
Original risk synthetic browser cases predate the focus repair; repaired browser acceptance is not established and historical strict teardown FAIL remains FAIL.

Committed historical ML aggregates report 691 rows, 592 correct, 99 errors, 85.6729% accuracy, 0.799833 macro-F1, 62.0839% majority-baseline accuracy and the recorded confusion matrix; no inference or generalization claim.
Runbook and presentation boundaries retain fail-closed/unavailable behavior and separate live/native admission; freeze dates are planned constraints, not delivery guarantees.
Original package FAIL/CONDITIONAL/BLOCKED/NO-GO classifications remain; this reduced route is documentation prepared for review with human timing NOT TESTED.
